capabilities: Embed notes, sections, or headers with dynamic content executing in the current note's context
Substitute dates into note names and headers using Moment.js formats with relative day offsets
Embed text ranges using after, from, and to anchors that support date substitution
Render deprecated Quoth code blocks and convert them to dynbedded blocks
Auto-refresh embeds at a configurable interval and style or attribute embedded content
extras: Checkbox checking inside embeds is fake and does not update the original note; links inside embed blocks are not real links, so renaming target notes breaks them. Additional documentation on the author's website (MMoMM.org, English and German) and YouTube videos; installable via BRAT; accepts Ko-Fi support.
intentEvidence: Full Quoth replacement. Dynbedded renders Quoth code blocks directly
motivation: The author says plugins like Dataview and Buttons 'were one of the reasons this plugin was created', and the plugin is based on the general idea from Dynamic Embed.
problem: Obsidian's built-in embeds are static and run embedded content in the embedded note's own context, so dynamic blocks like Dataview queries resolve against the wrong note, and note names cannot vary by date.

relations.evidence: Full Quoth replacement. Dynbedded renders Quoth code blocks directly
Based on the general idea from Dynamic Embed.
Dataview will not only be able to show information referenced from the current note
Buttons also works quite well with Dynbedded

summary: Dynamic embed plugin that embeds notes, sections, or ranges and executes dynamic content in the current note's context, with date-based name substitution.
